prompt: A single classic banker's desk lamp for a refined lawyer's office. A broad elongated emerald green glass lampshade, glossy dark green curved outer shell and pale cream inner surface, supported at both ends by polished antique brass arms. Elegant curved brass stem and a sturdy oval brass pedestal base. Small hanging pull chain, believable lamp construction, restrained traditional library style, warm brass and rich emerald palette. Entire lamp from base to shade, realistic proportions, clean smooth surfaces and PBR materials. Isolated lamp only, no desk, no room, no objects around it, no floor platform, no human, no text, no logo.
